TEACHING TRACK. Requirements verified: bachelor's degree ONLY - no certification, no master's, no teaching experience, no education background. Teach right away. || DILIGENCE - READ BEFORE APPLYING: 42% turnover, the highest of any NYC charter per state DOE (SA claims 17% excluding intra-network transfers). One SA high school reported 70% of staff not returning. Days run before 7am to ~5pm. Pay below comparable professional roles. Reviews call the workload 'crushing, exhausting, burns people out very quickly'; some first-year teachers quit teaching entirely. FAIR COUNTERPOINT: the model is deliberately built to survive turnover - standardized curriculum means a new teacher is not improvising, which is genuinely easier walking in cold. || CV: teaching variant now attached. || RESOLVED: NO cover letter field. Required: full street address, city, state, zip, country, and 'Have you completed your Bachelor's Degree?' Nothing to write. || MANHATTAN RESEARCH DONE. Success Academy runs 59 schools citywide; the Manhattan campuses are Harlem (ten of them), Hell's Kitchen, Hudson Yards, Midtown West, Union Square, Upper West and Washington Heights. || COMMUTE IS ACTUALLY A REASON TO PICK MANHATTAN: you are at 22 W 15th St, and there is a Union Square campus plus Hudson Yards and Midtown West nearby. For a day that starts before 7am that matters more than it sounds. || IT DOES SET YOU UP TO TEACH FAST - four weeks of structured training before you are alone with a class: one week off-site on a college campus doing seminars and mock lessons with school leaders, then three weeks teaching SA summer-school students. No certification required, no education background required; they market explicitly to career changers. You would be in a classroom by August. || BUT IT DOES NOT PRODUCE A CREDENTIAL. I found no evidence Success Academy sponsors or leads to New York State certification. So this buys classroom experience, not a portable qualification. That is the opposite trade from Transitional B / NYC Teaching Fellows, which is slower and demands a master's in education but ends with you certified. Decide which of those two you actually want before applying. || PAY IS BELOW THE FLOOR YOU NAMED: reported average SA salary in Manhattan is about $55,059 a year, with Associate Teacher around $52,427. That is under your ~$60K pivot floor, and Democracy Prep pays a first-year UNCERTIFIED teacher $68,707 for the same no-certification entry. || NEEDS YOU - SALARY ANSWER TENSION: I had pre-filled $70,000-$85,000, anchored on Democracy Prep. Against an SA band in the low-to-mid $50s that may screen you out on its own. Either lower it to roughly $60,000-$70,000 to stay inside their range, or keep the higher number and accept that it is a filter. Tell me which. || THE WAY OUT TO CERTIFIED IS NOT NYCTF - IT IS TRANSITIONAL A (CTE). New York has a CTE certification route built for exactly your profile: people with business and industry experience entering teaching. A district hires you on a Transitional A certificate, valid three years, during which you complete initial-certification requirements while employed and paid. The pathway options are graded by education plus experience, and OPTION J is 'bachelor's degree or higher IN THE CTE FIELD plus one year of work experience'. Your NYU Stern MBA is a graduate degree in business, and Business & Marketing is the CTE field, so you would clear Option J on the credential and overshoot the experience requirement fifteen times over. Option B is 'high school diploma plus four years work experience', which shows how low the industry bar is. || WHY THAT BEATS 'a year at SA then NYCTF': Transitional A puts you in a PUBLIC school on public pay with a pension, does not require a master's in education the way Transitional B and NYCTF do, does not wait for NYCTF's annual cycle, and lets you teach business, a subject you actually know, rather than elementary generalist. A year at Success Academy buys classroom experience and no credential, so it delays certification rather than advancing it. || ON ME: verify with NYSED Office of Teaching Initiatives that an MBA counts as 'in the CTE field' for Business & Marketing under Option J, and source NYC DOE CTE high schools hiring business teachers - Transitional A only activates when a district hires you under it.

TEACHING TRACK. || DILIGENCE DONE. PAY: first-year UNCERTIFIED $68,707, first-year certified $75,250, capping at $137,729; the schedule scales on certification status and lead-teaching years. CERTIFICATION: bachelor's required, state certification only PREFERRED - being uncertified is a pay tier here, not a gate, which resolves the screening flag on this card. || CULTURE - WORSE THAN SUCCESS ACADEMY ON THE QUALITATIVE AXIS: teachers rate it 2.5/5 across 145 reviews. items.geo: New York, NY (or SF) - full time, mode 1/3
items.notes: SUBMITTED 2026-07-29. Logged as application #2 in data/applications.md. Follow up ~2026-08-12. || VENTURE TRACK. Comp $150K-$200K, full time - this clears the ORIGINAL PM floor, not the pivot floor. Primary Labs is the firm's incubation engine, 20+ companies launched (Ollie, Tabs, LightTable). Reports to Partner Brian Schechter, who is 'actively incubating at the intersection of agents, edge, and AI'. || WHY THIS ONE: the stated thesis is 'agents are easily accessible and more people want their own agents but the experience remains elusive... a company designed to make agents more accessible, exploring topics that range from compute to privacy, commerce to social.' The work is building production-grade agents on local/edge compute, agent skill orchestration, and agentic devices. That is a literal description of what VP has spent three years building: the on-device PinePhone voice agent, the self-hosted fleet, the MCP servers. This is the one role where the homelab IS the qualification rather than something to frame carefully. || STRUCTURE: not fixed-term in the fellowship sense - OIRs 'have the opportunity to step into a founding role within a company they help incubate'. || NEEDS YOU: the role expects decks and memos as normal work product, so an interview exercise is plausible. Worth asking the format question early given the no-unpaid-work rule. || APPLICATION READY: form is four fields (name, email, LinkedIn, resume) plus a residency question - no cover letter, no essays, so the CV IS the whole application. Switched to the ai-infra variant and rewrote the current role to lead with the agent mesh: reasoning host, execution host, every reachable server, Telegram as the interface, the ARM phone as an edge node, and the portable context layer underneath. That answers three of their named focus areas at once - skill orchestration, agentic devices, and context compaction. || OPENCLAW - RESOLVED, AND IT INVERTS: they name OpenClaw explicitly. VP did not fail to adopt it - Llama Rider exists BECAUSE OpenClaw launched with public security flaws. He evaluated it, judged the security posture unacceptable for the access it wanted, had a hardened equivalent built instead, and has run and extended it since. That is now a CV bullet. For a firm whose thesis names privacy as a focus area, a build-vs-adopt call made on security grounds at the frontier is the judgment they are hiring for. || 'YOU CODE CONSTANTLY' - ANSWERED, VP's own words: 'I ship continuously by directing agents.' Use that line verbatim; it is the honest version and it is on-thesis for a firm betting that agent capability becomes the competitive frontier. || NO OPEN ITEMS. Ready to send on VP's go-ahead. || THE THESIS IS NOW ON THE PAGE: the CV opens with the actual why, not the what - 'how close a fully private cluster can get to frontier capability', with the hardware progression (Jetson to Orin AGX to DGX Spark) shown as deliberate investment toward that answer rather than accumulated kit. Primary's own thesis names 'compute to privacy' as territory they are exploring. That is a point of view, which is what an OIR is hired for - the posting asks for someone who maintains a pipeline of hypotheses and defends views with evidence.

VENTURE TRACK. On the technical axis this may be a CLOSER match than Primary. Their thesis, verbatim: 'Every team deploying models on edge devices rebuilds memory management, platform abstraction, and monitoring logic from scratch. The hardware is fragmenting across dozens of chipsets and runtimes. No single vendor's tools cover the stack.' You are living that: two Jetson Nanos, an Orin AGX and a DGX Spark, four chipsets, mixed Ollama and vLLM runtimes, behind a routing gateway you built precisely because no vendor's tools covered it. You have already built the abstraction layer they are describing as the opportunity. || NEEDS YOU - THIS IS A FOUNDER ROLE, NOT AN OPERATOR ROLE. You would be founding the company, not advising on it. Different risk profile from Primary's OIR entirely. Comp is not stated, and studio founder packages are usually a modest salary plus meaningful equity, so the $150K floor probably does not apply the way it does elsewhere. Decide whether you want founder risk before I prepare anything. || ADJACENT: Forum has other studio founder roles open - Robotics Middleware, Agentic Incident Management (manufacturing), AI Labor & Financial Operations. All Remote US. || RESOLVED: comp NOT stated. Remote US, full time. || NEEDS YOU BEFORE I PREPARE ANYTHING - this is a founder seat and you have not decided whether you want founder risk. Drafting an application before that decision is wasted work. || FORM INSPECTED: required questions are Pronouns, Background, 'Why did you pick this concept? Do you have domain expertise in this area?', 'Why is being a founder the right step for you right now?', how you heard about Forum, plus a stage checkbox (brainstorming / already have a co-founder / other). || I AM NOT DRAFTING 'why is being a founder the right step for you right now' - that is a conviction about your own life and I would be inventing it. Tell me your actual answer and I will shape it. The concept and domain-expertise question I CAN write, and it is your strongest card: four chipsets, mixed runtimes, and the abstraction layer you already built because no vendor's tools covered your fleet.

VENTURE TRACK. NYC, full time, EIR at a real firm (~$150mm AUM, runs Grand Central Tech; portfolio includes Maven, Eden Health, Octave). || HONEST CAVEAT: the studio is Terrarium and it is DIGITAL HEALTH specifically. You have no healthcare background. That is a genuine domain gap, not a framing problem, and it is a materially weaker fit than Primary or the Forum edge role. Listed because the format is right and NYC EIR seats are rare, not because the match is strong. Comp not stated. || RESOLVED: comp NOT stated. NYC, full time. || NEEDS YOU BEFORE I PREPARE ANYTHING - the digital-health domain gap is real and you may simply want to skip this one. || FORM INSPECTED, AND IT CONFIRMS THE GATE: required questions are a status radio (founder mode / transitioning out / founder curious / researching), 'Why do you want to start a company?', and 'What problem in healthcare are you most excited to solve?'. That last one is not a soft preference - they are asking for a healthcare thesis. You do not have one, and I will not manufacture one. My recommendation is to skip this unless you genuinely have a healthcare problem you care about, in which case tell me and I will build the answer around it.

items.notes: TEACHING TRACK - THIS DOMINATES BOTH CHARTER OPTIONS AND IT HAS A DEADLINE OF AUGUST 6. || BUSINESS IS A NYC CTE SUBJECT. VP's assumption that high schools have no business class is wrong for CTE programs specifically: NYC DOE names its CTE industries as architecture, construction, BUSINESS, healthcare and information technology. Not every comprehensive high school offers it, but the CTE programs and CTE high schools do. || NYC DOE HAS A PAGE FOR EXACTLY HIS PROFILE, 'Pathways for Industry Professionals': 'Aspiring CTE teachers with professional experience in a relevant field can apply directly for certification from NYSED. Once hired, CTE teachers earn a full-time teacher salary and benefits.' No education degree required. || PAY, AND THIS IS THE HEADLINE: the UFT schedule pays a teacher with a MASTER'S and no prior teaching experience $80,166 starting as of 2026-09-14. New teachers can also claim credit for up to 7.5 years of prior experience (to step 8B), so his 15 years may push him above that. Compare: Success Academy Manhattan averages about $55,059 and Democracy Prep pays an uncertified first-year $68,707. The public route pays roughly $25K MORE than Success Academy, adds a pension and union protection, AND leads to certification instead of nowhere. Ignore the ZipRecruiter figure of $58,304 for 'CTE business teacher' - the UFT schedule is the authoritative source and it is far higher. || NEEDS YOU: the NYCPS Teacher Application deadline is AUGUST 6, eight days out. Everything else in the queue can wait a week; this cannot. || ON ME: walk the actual application, and confirm whether the MBA satisfies the Option J 'degree in the CTE field' test or whether he enters via Option B (high school diploma plus 4 years experience), which he clears regardless. || EXPERIENCE VERIFICATION - NO SCHEDULE C NEEDED (VP's call, and the numbers back it): his W-2 employer years alone total about 12 (Conexant 2008-2011, Pace 2011-2013, Amazon 2015-2016, Kwik 2017-2018, Gravetti 2018-2020, Reco.AI 2020-2022). Every pathway needs at most 4 years, so Option B clears with 8 years spare and Option J with 11. Claim employer years only; leave the 2023-present independent period off the experience form. The real friction is employer reachability rather than paperwork type - Conexant was absorbed into NXP then Trident, and Gravetti and Kwik may be unreachable - so lead with Reco.AI, Gravetti and Amazon.
